content: Hi! How can I help you today?
I work from home for my sole proprietorship. Can I deduct part of my house?
Absolutely. If you use a space **exclusively and regularly** for business, you can deduct a **pro-rata share** of rent, utilities, insurance, and more using **Form 8829**.
Take the **square footage of your office divided by total home area**—then apply that percentage to indirect expenses. Direct repairs (e.g., repainting the office) are **100% deductible.**
Usually yes—it caps at $1,500. **For higher-cost areas or larger spaces**, detailed expense tracking via Form 8829 typically yields the **stronger deduction.**
